about: docs/OPERATIONS.md §8.113 19 (C1, K1) and 20 (g): the hand examples of step 2 (試し). Inputs are made-up bars and numbers; every answer below was derived by hand from the rule (the 'why' of each case), not by running the program. research/chartbest-hand.ts runs each case through the program's own functions (CB_MODE=hand) and writes hand-results.json; the Python runs every case through its own functions (chartbest-check.py --mode hand --hand); a planted error of hook 'hand' (20 (f)) must make at least one of its named cases fail. Prices are mids unless a case says bid/ask. Times are UTC. Version 2 (SQ-I2): every layout a case leaves to its runner is written in 'conventions' (read by both runners; no runner carries a layout value of its own), and 'fields' says what each case's fields hold. No case and no answer changed from version 1. Version 3 (step 2b's review fixes): conventions.hole and .half write the signals' warm-up (warmup 0; indep-05); conventions.holdLate and the kinds holdCalls and holdLate (a capped call's time from call records, SQ-PF1: the NY close τ; a late ULTRA signal in the owner-hold list, §8.111 2・3); the dab case text.dabABetter and the 0 form in text.judgments' s2.final (indep-08); fields.holdText's tau is the call's NY close τ; the placed shares of the holdText cases are the entered share (SQ-RC1: 9「今のメール2つの数字は、§8.111 の数字を再現して並べる」 with §8.111「置けた割合（入った件数 ÷ その半分のメール）」). Version 4 (step 2b's Python review fixer): the holdText case text.hold.noOppFill, a rate that does not exist printed 「—」 (SQ-H1 11; finding hold-null-rate-dash). No other case and no answer changed.

conventions.about: SQ-I2. The layout of the cases: values a case does not write itself but its answer was derived with. A runner of kind K takes a layout value from the subcase (follow.usdExact), else from the case itself (a case field of the same name overrides: follow.usdExact signalBid, signalAsk, spread, filler; follow.weekendGap signalAt, followAt; follow.unresolved count, tail, after; follow.short count), else from the group below whose usedBy names K (no key appears in two groups of one kind). A value found nowhere is an error of the case (it fails); a runner has no fallback of its own. None of these values is an answer: every answer is in a case's expect. Bars are 5-minute bars (1, 2): consecutive bars open 5 minutes apart and close 5 minutes after their open (T, 5). Each group's why quotes the example of 19 / 20 (g) it lays out.

midBars.why: 19「足は O/H/L/C（中値）。書いていない時刻の足は無い。」 and 2「中値: 四本値ごとに (Bid＋Ask)÷2 を double で出し、その double の正確な値を、ちょうど半分なら上へ丸める」: a bar given by its mids (or a flat bar of one mid) gets bid = mid − h and ask = mid + h on each of O, H, L and C, so that the chart's mid (2) is the given mid; h is two ticks of the pair.

periods.why: 1 fixes S0, START, SPLIT, END and the weeks of the halves (w0 = wk of START and of SPLIT); the hand cases that need a period use the plan's short development period 'mini' (made-up data only), whose dates the cases' whys count with (e.g. half: 「Mini period: SPLIT 2024-02-26 00:00」). A group names its period here.

k1.why: 19 K1「ユーロドル。見る日は次の3日だけ: 日1 2025-01-15（冬）は 07:55 と 15:55 UTC に始まる足がある。日2 2025-07-16（夏）は 06:55 と 14:55 UTC。日3 2025-03-12 …は 06:55 UTC だけ」 gives the bars' open times only; breedon reads the clock alone (18 K1), so every bar of the case's pair is flat at flatMid (midBars).

dst.why: 20 (g)「時刻: ロンドン・NY・東京の夏時間の切り替わり（2024-03-10・2024-03-31・2024-10-27・2024-11-03・2025-03-09・2025-03-30・2025-10-26・2025-11-02）と、NY とロンドンがずれる週の各項目の T。」 breedon is EUR/USD only (1). The bars: the case's context bar first (bar 0, which never signals, 5), then on each listed day a bar opening at each of barTimes (19 K1's bars of both seasons: 02:55 and 10:55 New York are 07:55 / 15:55 UTC in NY winter, 06:55 / 14:55 in NY summer), all flat at flatMid (midBars).

round.why: 20 (g)「丸め（150.0625 → 150.063、150.10249999… → 150.102）」 and 2「例: Bid 150.060・Ask 150.065 → double でちょうど 150.0625 → 150.063。Bid 150.100・Ask 150.105 → … → 150.102」: one bar opening at 'at' whose four bid prices are the case's bid and four ask prices its ask; the chart reads it at readAt, after its close (2「確定した足だけを使う」).

follow.why: 20 (g)「追い方: 上に先・下に先・始値で越える・1本で両方（amb）・水準ちょうど・未決着・休みの後。」 with 6「E ＝ 合図の足の中値の終値（2 の丸めの後）。入りは合図の足の終値（買いは Ask、売りは Bid）」 and 7「追う足: 始まりが T 以後の最初の5分足から、決済する側（買いは Bid、売りは Ask）で、ある足を1,440本（約5取引日）まで」. The signal bar opens at signalAt; its four bid prices are signalBid and its four ask prices signalAsk (E 150.000: a BUY fills at the ask 150.005, a SELL at the bid 149.995, as the cases' whys say). The bars after it open at followAt, followAt + 5 min, …: first the case's rows (bid O, H, L, C), then the filler bar repeated until count − (number of tail bars) bars stand after the signal bar, then the tail (its last bar is bar number count), then 'after' (bars beyond count). Every bar after the signal bar has ask = bid + spread on O, H, L and C. The filler reaches no level of a trade at E 150.000 (BUY on the bid: stop 149.870, TP4 150.040, TP10 150.100; SELL on the ask: stop 150.130, TP4 149.960, TP10 149.900). count 1,441 is one bar more than the 1,440 followed (7: the 1,441st is never read). These are the yen cases' values (USD/JPY near 150); a case on another pair gives its own (follow.usdExact).

mirror.why: 20 (g)「鏡と e（+1・0・−1）。」 with 8「鏡: 同じ T・同じ E で、向きだけ逆の取引。」「ブラインドの表: 各ペア・各半分の、①〜④を通ったすべての5分足の確定で、買いとその鏡（売り）を同じ作りで追う（利確4と10の両方）。」 Each world holds one pair only (no other pair has a bar, so no 5-minute slot is open and there is no hole, 6 ③), in the half 'half' of the period 'period' (its table read to SPLIT, 12): a bar opening at signalAt with its four bid prices signalBid and four ask prices signalAsk (E 150.000), then from followAt the world's rows (bid O, H, L, C; ask = bid + spread) and the filler up to count bars after it, exactly the 1,440 the row follows (7), so that this bar is the world's only blind row (④ drops every later bar).

events.why: 20 (g)「出来事: 常に持つ型（0→+1、+1→−1、+1→0→+1、最初に決まった足）、条件型、名前ごと、両向きの足、判断しない足の次の足…」 with 5: a made-up item of the seq's type with no warm-up, no retained rule (置6) and no mark, whose conditions are the seq's values, one bar per value: the pair's bars open at start, start + 5 min, … and are flat at flatMid (midBars). Only the event framework (5 ① ② ④ and its counts) is judged, not the reasons ①〜④ of 6.

hole.why: 20 (g)「窓の穴（6枠と5枠、開いていない枠で切れる）。」 with 6 ③: each of the five pairs has a flat bar (flatMid, midBars) every 5 minutes from the case's start up to but not including its end, except the case's missing opens; the period is 'period' with its S0 and END replaced by the case's start and end (the 5-minute slots looked at are those of [S0, END)), its START and SPLIT kept, so the signal bars' T lie inside START..END. warmup: the case's signals belong to no item, so they have no warm-up (warmup 0: a signal on bar i is past the warm-up when i ≥ 0, as the run's records count it; 5「温め: 項目の表の温めがそろうまで、合図は出さない」 is an item's), written here as 19「例を小さくするため、本数や温めを縮めたものは、そう書いた。」 asks.

half.why: 20 (g)「半分（SPLIT の直前と直後、追う窓が SPLIT をまたぐ合図）。」 with 1 and 6 ④: the pair's flat bars (flatMid, midBars) every 5 minutes from the case's from to its to, both included, with no hole, in the period 'period' (its SPLIT 2024-02-26 00:00 is the one the case's why counts with). warmup: the case's signals belong to no item, so they have no warm-up (warmup 0: a signal on bar i is past the warm-up when i ≥ 0, as the run's records count it; 5「温め: 項目の表の温めがそろうまで、合図は出さない」 is an item's), written here as 19「例を小さくするため、本数や温めを縮めたものは、そう書いた。」 asks.

deltaT.why: 20 (g)「Δ（層・重み・ブラインドの項を手で出した値と）、ブラインドに e が無い層」「Δ の季節: … 層の数と、各層のブラインドの数を、手で出した値と比べる。」 with 8 and 1: each observation's stratum comes from the case's layer, pair and direction and its T (8), its week is wk(T) and its 4-week block floor((wk(T) − w0) ÷ 4) with the w0 of half 'half' of period 'period' (1).

clusters.why: 20 (g)「塊（週・4週・10に足りない時）」 with 8「塊: 週（wk(T)）と4週（1）。4週の塊が10に足りなければ週だけ。」: in each set, position k holds one signal and one blind observation, both in stratum 'stratum', in week weeks[k] and 4-week block blocks[k]; their values v (e ÷ 2) are sigVCycle[k mod its length] and blindVCycle[k mod its length]. The answers (the SE candidates' kinds and their C) depend on the weeks and blocks only.

table.why: 20 (g)「週ずらし（輪・落とす合図・SD）」 and 「文の勝率の分母（決着の中）と、目をつぶった場合の層の重みの手の例。」 with 8「ブラインドの表…」: a blind table of one pair written by hand: one row per bar open the case gives (T = open + 5 min, E = mid; the pair's bars are flat at mid (midBars) at those opens only, the other four pairs have no bar), in half 'half' of period 'period' (4-week blocks from its w0), layer 'layer' (strata of 8). Each row has the four legs BUY / SELL × TP4 / TP10 (8); a leg the case does not give is 'legs': a stop decided on the first bar after the row's bar, at −13.5 pips (7: E − 13 pips, filled half a pip away).

winDenominator.why: 20 (g)「文の勝率の分母（決着の中）と、目をつぶった場合の層の重みの手の例。」 with 9: the case's trades are TP4 outcomes at tradesFrom, tradesFrom + 5 min, …, each with tradePips pips (W and its denominators do not read the pips); the case's signals are signalDir signals on the rows of the hand-written table (group table) whose BUY e is rowE for every row, so every signal and every blind row has e and enters Δ's strata (8), whose weights the blind W1 and PL1 take.

sepick.why: 20 (g)「使う SE の選び方」 with 8「幅の半分 t(0.975, 自由度) × 標準誤差 が一番広いものを使う（同じなら週・4週・週ずらしの順）」: each candidate is given by its half-width; its C and df are these (the same for all, so they decide nothing) and its SE is the half-width × sePerHalf (the choice compares the half-widths only).

select.why: 20 (g)「選び方（下の端の順・同じ値・重なりの組で飛ばす・選べる項目が足りない）」 with 12「選べる項目（すべて満たす）: 床を通る。確かめ（20）がすべて通る。前半の t が作れて、Δ が0より大きい（点）。疑う合図（13）に当たっていない。」: every row's item passed the floor; the run's checks all passed (checksPass); suspicion is not counted only (countsOnlySuspicion false: not set H); no yardstick was hit (yardstickHits empty, 13). A row with an LB has t = tWhenLb (12 needs only that t exists), a row with LB null has no t. fill lays out the rest of a row (on the made-up rows of group rows), which 12 does not read: Δ's SE deltaSe on df, Δ_late [Δ, lateLoHi], a, w4 and w10 as [W of the resolved, PL].

groups.why: 20 (g)「重なりの組: A と C、C と B の重なりが0.5以上で、A と B は0.5未満、C が床を通らない時、A と B は別の組（C をはさんでつながない）。」 with 11「A→B と B→A の大きい方が0.5以上なら同じ組。」: the case's overlap gives share(A→B) under the key 'A>B'; a key not given is missingShare (so a pair of items without entries is joined only by 11's forced joins). The answers name each group by its member first in the table's order (3「表の順」).

suspect.why: 20 (g)「床と疑う合図（線ちょうどと1つ下）。」 with 13: each item overrides fields of the case's base row. A W array (w4 for TP4, w10 for TP10) holds the values named by wFields in that order; the row's trade count n equals its resolved count, and its other counts are otherCounts (13 reads none of them). late null means Δ_late is the field named by lateWhenNull (Δ); an item without 'blind' is an item's row (blind true: a blind row, where the Δ lines are not applied, SQ-16).

rows.why: 20 (g)「判定と文（4つの判定、一部の3つの形〈C5 を含む・C4 を含み C5 を含まない・C2・C3 だけ〉…今のメールとの比べの3つの形…）」 and the D_AB examples「D_AB ＝ −3.0・SE 1.87〈A と B が無関係とした時の √(0.5²＋1.8²)〉」: a made-up row of a half. An estimate [Δ, SE] on df has C = df + 1 week clusters (8: 自由度 C − 1) and no 4-week block; cluster g (0 … C − 1) carries the influence sum a × p[g mod length of p] with p its pattern and a = SE × √(C − 1) ÷ C, so that the week SE √(C ÷ (C − 1) × Σ S_g²) of 8 equals the given SE; the patterns alt (+, −, …) and pairs (+, +, −, −, …) are uncorrelated, so the difference of two estimates on the two patterns has SE √(SE_A² + SE_B²), as the examples assume. SE null: no cluster, no t. An item's Δ is on its own pattern (itemPattern unless it gives one), its a on itemPattern. Δ_late [Δ_late, low end, high end] is a point with its interval and no SE. Each row has N e-signals in one stratum (none dropped), counted and nE as below, no unresolved trade and no signal without a Δ_late term; all its TP4 and TP10 trades are resolved (n = resolved; tp = round(W × resolved), sl = resolved − tp, no amb, none open; W of all = W of the resolved, intervals none); the blind's W1 and PL1 under its strata are blindW1 and blindPl1; it has no pair row (byPair: C3 not applied, q = 0 < 3) and a direction it does not give has no e-signals (C2 sees nothing there). Its suspicious lines come from its own numbers (13). The emails' rows (ULTRA 5分足, MACD) take Δ as their case's group says (text, dab), Δ_late as one point (low = high = Δ), a, w4 and w10 from email; their chart and calendar layers are the same row. No owner's-way row is given to the sentences.

text.why: 20 (g)「今のメールとの比べの同時の下の端（t(1 − 0.025÷K_total, 自由度)）の手の例。片方だけが下の端0を超える例。」 with 14: K_total is the number of the case's items (one per scenario); both emails' Δ are emailDelta (a scenario gives the ULTRA and MACD Δ itself) with SE emailSe on the pattern emailPattern, uncorrelated with an item's alt, so D_U and D_M have SE √(SE_item² + emailSe²). A scenario's single item is scenarioItem (Δ, Δ_late, a, w4, w10 as in an item of the case).

dab.why: 20 (g)「下の端で選んだ A の点が B より低い例（K_total ＝ 4、自由度が大きい時の t ≈ 2.498 …）」「B の方が当たると言える例（同じ t …）」 with 14: the case's items [id, Δ, SE] in its order (A first, B second); item k is on the pattern patternByIndex[k] (B on pairs, the others on alt: A and B uncorrelated, D_AB's SE √(SE_A² + SE_B²)); each item's Δ_late is [Δ, item.lateLo, Δ + item.lateHiAboveEst] (low end above 0: C4 passes) and its a, w4, w10 are item's; both emails' Δ are emailDelta with SE emailSe (null: no t, no interval); M_1 is m1.

holdLate.why: §8.111 2・3 and 9: one pair's flat 5-minute bars (flatMid, midBars) at the subcase's opens only (an open not written is a missing bar); one late ULTRA signal of direction dir on the subcase's bar i (T = that bar's open + 5 min; the signal first shows in the window of bar i + 1) and no on-time signal, put into the owner-hold list of the full account of period 'period' (START ≦ T < END). The list holds it, with late 1, base and P = base + 2 min, or not at all.

fields.about: What the case fields of each kind hold (read with the case's why and the conventions above). Indices of bars start at 0; T is a bar's close (open + 5 min, 5); directions are "BUY" / "SELL"; Δ, a, SE and W are fractions (0.04 = 4.0 points, 0.7 = 70%), pips are pips.
fields.c1: pair; start: bar 0's open; n: donchian's n (19 C1 shortens it); bars: each bar's mid [O, H, L, C]; expect.signals: [bar index, direction] in bar order; expect.target: donchian's target s per bar (0, +1, −1; 18 C1, SQ-01).
fields.k1: pair; bars: the open times of the only bars there are (flat, conventions.k1); expect: per item (breedon-1, breedon-2) its signals [T, direction, marks] in time order.
fields.dst: context: the open of the first bar; days: [day, breedon-1's signal T (a SELL), breedon-2's signal T (a BUY), the season group at both T: WW both winter, SS both summer, SW New York summer and London winter (the shifted weeks; the mark shiftedWeek)].
fields.round: pair; bid, ask: the bar's four bid / ask prices; expect: the chart's mid written with the pair's decimals.
fields.follow: pair; dir; tp: 10 (TP10) or 4 (TP4); rows, count, tail, after: see conventions.follow; subcases: layouts that share the case's other fields, each with its own rows (and count, tail, after) and expect; expect.kind: tp, sl, amb or open (unresolved), null: not followed (6 ④); expect.pips: the trade's pips; expect.bars: the follow bar on which the trade ended (1 = the first bar after the signal bar; 1440 when unresolved).
fields.mirror: worlds: [{rows: the bid [O, H, L, C] of the bars after the row's bar, e: the e of the BUY row (the SELL row's is its negative)}].
fields.sent: items: [T, whether a signal with this T is sent (6 ②)].
fields.events: seqs: [{type: always, condition or named; target (always): the target per bar, 0, 1, −1 or null (none); buy, sell (condition): per bar 1 holds, 0 does not hold, −1 none; namedBuy (named): per bar the BUY names that hold (no SELL name); expect: {signals: [bar, direction], firstSkipped, nullPrevSkipped, bothSuppressed: the counts of 5}}].
fields.hole: start, end: see conventions.hole; missing: per pair the opens without a bar; expect.holes: per pair the holes [from, to) (6 ③); expect.overlap: [a USD/JPY bar's open, whether the window of a signal on it (6 ③: from the open of the 10th newest bar, the signal bar being the newest, to T) overlaps a hole, which is also whether its reason is ③].
fields.half: from, to: see conventions.half; expect: [a bar's open, its reason (counted, r1 … r4 for ①〜④), its half or null].
fields.delta: sig, blind: observations [stratum, week, 4-week block, v = e ÷ 2]; expect: est (Δ), N, strata, dropped (signals in strata without a blind e), use (the SE used), se, C, df (of the SE used), kinds (the SE candidates in the order week, 4w, shift).
fields.deltaT: pair, dir, layer (chart or cal); sig, blind: [T, v = e ÷ 2], strata and clusters as conventions.deltaT says; expect: as delta, plus blindPerStratum (the blind rows of each stratum that holds a signal and a blind row, strata in ascending order) and seasons (the season group of each signal's T, in the case's order).
fields.clusters: sets: [{weeks, blocks: one position per signal / blind observation, see conventions.clusters; kinds: the SE candidates' kinds; C: their cluster counts}].
fields.shift: rows: [bar open, e of the BUY row] of the hand-written table (conventions.table); signals: [T, direction]; expect: k (the shifts tried, 1 … W_h − 1), delta (Δ_k), dropped (signals dropped at each k), sd (SD_shift), mean (of Δ_k), rank (of the real Δ among them), real (the real Δ of the signals).
fields.sepick: items: [[[candidate kind, its half-width], …], the kind used].
fields.tq: items: [df, t(0.975, df)]; tol: the tolerance.
fields.lbcount: ids: items above 0; groups: {item: its overlap group}; expect: {items, groups}: their counts (12); p95: [values, their 95% point (10)].
fields.select: sets: [{rows: [item, Δ, LB (null: no t), e-signals, suspicious lines], groups: {item: its overlap group (11)}, expect: {chart, cal: the items chosen in order of choice, notEligible: {item: suspicious | noT | nonPositive}}}].
fields.holm: sets: [{items: [item, p, t (null: none), e-signals], expect: {item: [Holm rank, passes]}}].
fields.groups: overlap: {'A>B': share(A→B)}; sets: [{items: the floor-passing items, expect: {item: its group's name}}].
fields.floor: items: [[first half's counted signals, weeks], [second half's counted signals, weeks], passes the floor].
fields.suspect: base: a row {delta, a, late, w4, w10}; items: [fields that override base (blind: true for a blind row), the suspicious lines expected, named delta, a, w2, w1, pl1, pl2, zeroHundred, lateGap and listed in the order of 13's list of lines].
fields.textNumbers: items: [format (pts: points, pct: a win rate, pips, yen), value, the text].
fields.winDenominator: trades: TP4 outcomes (tp, sl, amb, open); expectW: {n, resolved, wRes (W of the resolved), wAll (W of all)}; rows: [bar open, kind of its BUY TP4 leg, that leg's pips] of the hand-written table (conventions.table); signals: the T of the signals (conventions.winDenominator); expect: {blindW1, blindPl1}: the blind's W1 and PL1 weighted by the signals' strata (9).
fields.text: df, m1 (M_1); items: [{id, delta: [Δ, SE], late: [Δ_late, low end, high end], a: [a, SE], w4: [W1 of the resolved, PL1], w10: [W2, PL2], byDir (optional): {BUY: [Δ, e-signals], SELL: …}, pattern (optional)}] (conventions.rows); or scenarios: [{item, ultra and macd: the emails' Δ, contains}]; expect: {judgments: {item: confirmed | bad | partial | cannot}, forms: {item: i | ro | ha}, text: {sentence id: {contains, absent, startsWith}}}; the sentence ids are s2.item.<item> and s2.final (21).
fields.dab: df; items: [item, Δ, SE] (conventions.dab); expect: {promote: the item promoted to stage 3, confirmed: the confirmed items, se: D_AB's SE, contains: fragments of s2.final}.
